message.content: Mark DeSaulnier, running for California's 10th congressional district, has sponsored the Block the Bombs Act and the UNRWA Funding Emergency Restoration Act, and in July 2025 stated he no longer votes for offensive military aid to Israel, calling the Gaza situation unacceptable by any standards of humanity. He voted against the $17.6 billion and $14 billion Israel aid packages, the $3.3 billion State Department military aid appropriation, and the 2026 and 2027 NDAAs tying U.S. and Israeli defense spending, and in July 2026 voted to eliminate $3.3 billion in military aid to Israel. He has not called the killing in Gaza a genocide and did not sponsor that recognition bill. Earlier in the Congress he voted for a spending bill cutting UNRWA funding, for a resolution affirming Israel's right to exist, and for a one-sided resolution condemning only Hamas. He is endorsed by CAIR Action and rated an Ally by Vote for Peace, while also holding endorsements from the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club and JStreetPAC, reflecting a record that has moved toward opposing military aid to Israel without reaching a genocide finding.
